description: This file defines the TimesheetPeriodService class, which manages timesheet period configurations in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for retrieving, setting, and parsing timesheet period data from XML configuration, leveraging factory and configuration services.

classes.name: TimesheetPeriodService
classes.description: Service class providing management and retrieval of timesheet period configurations, including parsing XML data and interacting with configuration and factory classes.

methods.name: getDefinedTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the defined timesheet period for a given current date by parsing configuration XML.

methods.name: getDaysOfTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the days within the timesheet period based on provided XML data and current date.

methods.name: isTimesheetPeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the timesheet period has been set in the configuration.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Sets and saves the timesheet period start day configuration using factory and configuration services.

methods.name: getTimesheetHeading
methods.description: Retrieves the heading/title of the timesheet period from configuration XML.

methods.name: getTimesheetStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the timesheet period from configuration XML.
